Senses.Explanation: The graphs join “hidden” or “subtle” with a trigger, pivot, or working. Chan records use the compound for workings disclosed in sayings, gestures, and exchanges. One verse calls them “subtle workings and marvelous function” and immediately lists raising the whisk, lifting the eyebrows, and answering questions. Another stock line says that “subtle workings beyond the norms” seek one who knows; a verse warns that people who try to grasp what precedes the working violate it beneath the phrase. The corpus can also negate it: “the intent cuts off subtle workings” stands beside “the myriad things do not arise.”
